info.headline: TEST: Heavy rainfall warning: Bududa - 3-day total 153 mm, 3.4x the seasonal 95th percentile
info.description: Rainfall in the 3 days to 31 Jul 2022 averaged 153 mm over Bududa, 3.4 times the district's 1991-2020 95th percentile of 3-day totals for this time of year (44 mm; seasonal mean 15 mm). 100% of the district was above its local 95th percentile and the wettest location received 166 mm. Triggers met: Wettest location in the district received at least 100 mm in 3 days; District-mean 3-day rainfall of at least 80 mm; At least half of the district above its local 1991-2020 95th percentile of 3-day totals (and a district mean of at least 50 mm); 3-day district-mean rainfall above the district-mean 95th percentile of 1991-2020 3-day totals for this time of year (and at least 40 mm). Data: SYNTHETIC.
info.instruction: Flooding, flash floods and landslides are likely in low-lying areas, along rivers and on steep slopes. District disaster management committees: activate contingency plans and prepare to move people out of high-risk areas. Public: do not cross flooded rivers or streams, keep away from landslide-prone slopes and follow instructions from local authorities.
